Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 8 Social Impact Assessment

Clause 2.8 - other (development_control): A social impact assessment (SIA) aims to predict the positive or negative impact that development or land use change may have on people’s way of life, their culture, or their community.

Clause 2.8.5 - other (development_control): A SIC or SIS is required with any development application if, in the opinion of Council, a proposed development is likely to have a significant impact on the community.
